import mlx.core as mx,json,time,statistics
mx.set_default_device(mx.gpu)
g=mx.distributed.init(strict=True,backend="ring")
y=mx.full((1,1,5120),0.0,dtype=mx.bfloat16); mx.eval(y)
samples=[]
for trial in range(8):
 start=time.perf_counter()
 for i in range(128):
  x=mx.tanh(y*0.125+(g.rank()+1)).astype(mx.bfloat16); mx.eval(x)
  y=mx.distributed.all_sum(x,group=g,stream=mx.cpu); mx.eval(y)
 samples.append(time.perf_counter()-start)
assert mx.all(mx.isfinite(y)).item()
print(json.dumps({"rank":g.rank(),"world_size":g.size(),"shape":list(y.shape),"dtype":str(y.dtype),"allreduce_calls_per_chain":128,"chain_seconds":samples,"warmup_chains":1,"warm_median_chain_ms":1000*statistics.median(samples[1:]),"final_value":float(y[0,0,0].item()),"scope":"isolated dependent GPU pointwise producer+eval+CPU ring sum+eval; not matmul or full-model timing"}))
